players.bio: Ajahni "AJ" Wallace (born 31 March 2003) is a Jamaica international rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League.

Anthony Marion (born 12 January 1994) is a French professional rugby league footballer who plays as a loose forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Championship and France at international level. He can also play hooker or in the halves. Marion was the back-up goal-kicker to Mark Kheirallah for Toulouse in the Championship.
Brendan Hands (born 12 February 1999) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as hooker for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League.

Calum Gahan (born 23 April 1997) is a Scotland international rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League. He previously played for the London Broncos in the Championship.

César Rougé (born 3 October 2002) is a French professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half, hooker or stand-off for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League and France at international level. In 2021 he made his Catalans debut in the Super League against St Helens.

Henry O'Kane (born 5 April 2002) is an Ireland international rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League He was previously contracted to the Wests Tigers in the National Rugby League (NRL).
Jake Shorrocks (born 26 October 1995) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half or stand-off for the Toulouse Olympique in the Championship.

James Roumanos (born 10 August 1999) is a Lebanon international rugby league footballer who plays as a lock or prop forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League. He previously played for the Manly Warringah Sea Eagles in the National Rugby League.

Joe Bretherton (born 5 October 1995) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for Toulouse Olympique in the Championship. He previously played for Wigan Warriors in the Super League.

Joe Cator (born 15 June 1998) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a loose forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Championship. He played for Hull Kingston Rovers in the Championship and the Super League, and on loan from Hull KR at the Coventry Bears and the Newcastle Thunder in Betfred League 1. Cator also played for the Leigh Centurions in the Betfred Championship.

Lambert Belmas (born 11 August 1997) is a French professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League and France at international level. He previously played for the Catalans Dragons and FC Lézignan XIII. Belmas has spent time on loan at Saint-Esteve in the Elite One Championship.
Luke Polselli (born 6 August 1998) is an Italy international rugby league footballer who plays as a centre or fullback for Toulouse Olympique in the Super League.
Mathieu Jussaume (born 17 May 1999) is a professional rugby league player with Toulouse Olympique in Super League. He plays centre and is a product of the Toulouse academy system.

Maxime Stefani (born 10 March 1998) is a French professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for Toulouse Olympique in the Championship and France at international level. He previously played for the Saint-Gaudens Bears.

Oliver Ashall-Bott (born 24 November 1997) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback or winger for the Toulouse Olympique in the Championship. He previously played for the Huddersfield Giants, Wakefield Trinity and Widnes Vikings in the Super League and the Championship, and on loan from Widnes at the North Wales Crusaders in League 1.
Paul Marcon (born 10 July 1995) is a French professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for Toulouse Olympique in the Championship and France at international level.

Paul Ulberg (born 14 November 1995) is a Cook Islands international rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for Toulouse Olympique in the English Super League He previously played for the London Broncos in the Championship.
Reubenn Rennie (born 22 October 1995) is a Cook Islands international rugby league footballer who plays as a centre for the Toulouse Olympique in the English Super League.

Rob Butler (born 15 May 1998) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop forward for Toulouse Olympique in the RFL Championship and the England Knights at international level.
Sylvain Houles born 3 August 1981) is the head coach of Toulouse Olympique in the Super League and a French former professional rugby league footballer.

Tyler Dupree (born 8 February 2000) is a rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for Toulouse Olympique on season-long loan, from the Wigan Warriors in the Super League. He previously spent time on loan from the Leeds Rhinos at the York City Knights, Featherstone Rovers and the Batley Bulldogs in the Championship.
